T: Get the honey. Get the bear.
D: A boy raised by wolves journeys through the jungle with a panther and a bear as a tiger hunts him.
P: Serve dessert when Mowgli climbs the cliff to bring Baloo the honey.
S: Toasted sourdough fingers with honey ricotta, extra honey drizzled over
Thick sourdough toasted, spread with ricotta whipped with a little honey, drizzled with more honey and scattered with crushed walnuts.
Mango, pineapple, banana and lychees with lime juice and chilli salt
Mango, pineapple and banana cut into chunks with lychees, squeezed with lime and sprinkled with chilli salt.
Peace Rock potato and pea samosas
fried pastry triangles of crushed potato, cumin seed and ginger, mint yoghurt, for the dry season

Spiced potato and pea filling with garam masala folded into pastry triangles, fried at 180C until crisp, with mint yoghurt. Boil 600g diced potatoes until just tender. Fry 1 diced onion in oil, add 1 tsp cumin seeds, 2 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp grated ginger and a green chilli. Add the potatoes and 1 cup frozen peas and crush lightly, then season and cool. Cut 6 sheets spring roll pastry into 3 strips each, fold spoonfuls into triangles and seal with flour paste. Fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Serve with yoghurt mixed with mint and lemon.
M: thighs simmered in tomato, ginger and garam masala with coconut milk, served with basmati and naan

Chicken thighs simmered in a tomato and coconut curry with ginger and garam masala, with basmati rice and naan. Fry 1 diced onion in oil for 8 minutes, add 3 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 2 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp turmeric and 1 tsp chilli powder for 1 minute. Add 800g diced chicken thigh and stir to coat. Pour in a 400g tin crushed tomatoes and a 400ml tin coconut milk and simmer 30 minutes until thick. Stir in coriander and lime. Serve with 1.5 cups basmati rice and 4 warm naan.
Lamb shoulder rubbed with cumin and garlic, roasted five hours, with flatbread
Lamb shoulder rubbed with cumin and garlic, slow roasted at 150C for 5 hours, with flatbread.
W: Crunchy golden honeycomb made with golden syrup, honey and bicarb soda
Sugar, golden syrup and honey boiled to 150C, bicarb whisked in so it foams, set and broken into chunks, dipped in chocolate.
K: Mango, Greek yoghurt, milk and cardamom blended thick, over ice
Mango blended with yoghurt, milk and cardamom over ice.

note.text: Relax, kid. Grab some fruit off the tree and lie back. Dinner's better when nobody's in a hurry.

winks: Mowgli and Raksha, his wolf mother

s.note: Bagheera's watch, one eye on Shere Khan.

dishes.make_ahead: Beat the ricotta with the honey and crush the walnuts up to 2 days ahead, covered in the fridge; toast the sourdough and assemble just before serving

steps.text: Beat the ricotta with some of the honey until light. Crush the walnuts.
Toast thick slices of sourdough and cut into fingers.
Spread with ricotta, drizzle with more honey and scatter with walnuts.

dishes.make_ahead: Cut the mango and pineapple up to 4 hours ahead, chilled; add the bananas, lime and chilli salt just before serving

steps.text: Cut the mango, pineapple and bananas into chunks and drain the lychees.
Toss together in a big bowl and squeeze over lime juice.
Sprinkle with salt mixed with chilli flakes.

dishes.make_ahead: Rub the lamb up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; roast on the day, or roast up to 2 days ahead and reheat in its juices

steps.text: Rub the lamb with cumin, crushed garlic, oil and salt.
Roast covered at 150C until it pulls apart.
Stir crushed garlic through the yoghurt.
Pull the lamb apart and serve on a board with warm flatbread and garlic yoghurt.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the garlic yoghurt up to 2 days ahead, chilled; rub and roast the pumpkin on the night

steps.text: Rub the pumpkin with the cumin, 3 crushed garlic cloves, oil and salt and lay in a roasting tray.
Roast covered at 200C for 20 minutes, then uncover, add the chickpeas and roast until the pumpkin is soft and charred at the edges.
Crush the last garlic clove and stir it through the yoghurt.
Pile the pumpkin and chickpeas on a board and serve with warm flatbread and garlic yoghurt.
Line a tin with baking paper.
Boil the sugar, golden syrup and honey to 150C.
Off the heat, whisk in the bicarb soda so it foams, and pour into the tin.
Leave to set.
Break into chunks and dip half of each in melted dark chocolate.

dishes.make_ahead: Best blended just before serving; peel and slice the mangoes up to 1 day ahead and keep them chilled

steps.text: Peel and slice the mangoes.
Blend with the yoghurt, milk and cardamom until smooth.
Pour over ice in tall glasses.

Wolf pack lamb.veg: Cumin and garlic pumpkin wedges and chickpeas, roasted golden, with yoghurt and flatbread

s.note: Toasted sourdough fingers with honey ricotta, extra honey drizzled over
s.how: Beat 250g ricotta with 2 tbsp honey until light. Toast thick slices of sourdough, cut into fingers and spread with the ricotta. Drizzle with more honey and scatter with crushed walnuts. A bear would steal the lot.

s.note: Mango, pineapple, banana and lychees with lime juice and chilli salt
s.how: Cut a mango, half a pineapple and 2 bananas into chunks and toss with a drained can of lychees. Squeeze over lime juice and sprinkle with a little salt mixed with chilli flakes. Pile it high in a big bowl for a temple full of monkeys.

m.note: Lamb shoulder rubbed with cumin and garlic, roasted five hours, with flatbread
m.how: Rub a 2kg lamb shoulder with ground cumin, crushed garlic, oil and salt. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart. Serve on a board with warm flatbread and garlic yoghurt for the whole pack.

w.note: Crunchy golden honeycomb made with golden syrup, honey and bicarb soda
w.how: Boil 200g sugar, 3 tbsp golden syrup and 2 tbsp honey to 150C. Take off the heat and whisk in 2 tsp bicarb soda so it foams up. Pour into a lined tin and leave to set. Break into chunks and dip half of each in melted dark chocolate.

d.note: Mango, Greek yoghurt, milk and cardamom blended thick, over ice
d.how: Blend 2 mangoes with 300g Greek yoghurt, 250ml cold milk and a pinch of ground cardamom until smooth. Pour over ice in tall glasses. Cool and thick, made for a hot day at the Peace Rock.
